CREATE TABLE "public"."matter" (
  "matter_id" bigint DEFAULT nextval('matter_matter_id_seq'::regclass) NOT NULL,
  "case_number" text NOT NULL,
  "docket_number" text,
  "title" text NOT NULL,
  "case_type" case_type NOT NULL,
  "status" case_status NOT NULL,
  "open_date" date NOT NULL,
  "close_date" date,
  "statute_limitations_date" date,
  "description" text,
  "jurisdiction" text NOT NULL,
  "client_party_id" bigint,
  "created_at" timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now() NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now() NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "matter_case_number_key" UNIQUE ("case_number"),
  CONSTRAINT "matter_client_party_id_fkey" FOREIGN KEY (client_party_id) REFERENCES party(party_id) MATCH SIMPLE ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE NO ACTION,
  CONSTRAINT "matter_dates_chk" CHECK (close_date IS NULL OR close_date >= open_date),
  CONSTRAINT "matter_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("matter_id"),
  CONSTRAINT "matter_sol_date_chk" CHECK (statute_limitations_date IS NULL OR statute_limitations_date >= open_date),
  CONSTRAINT "matter_status_close_date_chk" CHECK ((status = ANY (ARRAY['closed'::case_status, 'archived'::case_status])) AND close_date IS NOT NULL OR (status <> ALL (ARRAY['closed'::case_status, 'archived'::case_status])))
);
